look_here_first: Recognize a climbing/twining vine with opposite triangular to heart-shaped leaves and loose clusters of tiny whitish to pinkish composite heads; inspect heads with four florets and phyllaries.
photo_note: One attributed provisional species-recognition photograph; detailed diagnostic anatomy, synonym concepts and county-native screening incomplete.
identification_caution: Do not claim local occurrence from this source photo; distinguish from other climbing Asteraceae.
